summary: Frontend-only Budgetly tested end-to-end (backend intentionally not tested — major architectural change: app is now 100% client-side with IndexedDB). All 13 requested scenarios pass. ZERO backend /api/ requests across the entire browsing session. HashRouter direct-URL/refresh works. Backup download/restore round-trip, malformed-file safety, sample data load, recurring autopilot dedup across reloads, 14 feature pages render without errors, and base-currency persistence after reload all verified. No critical issues found.
critical_code_review_comments: Backup is unencrypted plain JSON (acknowledged in UI copy) — fine for MVP; consider optional passphrase encryption later.
`validateBackup` accepts missing array stores silently (treats undefined as 0 count). Acceptable but could warn on partial backups.
Backup/download has no size/space pre-check; on very large DBs quota errors would propagate as unhandledrejection and show the generic storage toast — already handled in Boot.

`Setup.js` still imports/uses `api` wrapper (good — abstracts IndexedDB). Note that `settings.base_currency` save path requires explicit Save click; make this clear via a dirty-state indicator (minor UX).
test_credentials: None — app is local, no auth.
seed_data_creation: Used built-in 'Load sample data' button to seed; cleaned up implicitly via subsequent restores.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Browser context is important: this test deleted indexedDB('budgetly_db') before starting to simulate a fresh customer. The hidden <input type='file' data-testid='restore-file-input'> cannot be waited-on with wait_for_selector (it's display:hidden); use set_input_files() directly. Note: locator '[data-testid^="txn-"]' also matches UI testids like txn-tab-all/txn-tab-recurring/txn-tab-variable/txn-month-filter (4 non-row elements), so transaction row counts are N-4 of what the locator returns. Base-currency change requires clicking the 'save-settings-btn' — merely changing the select does not persist.
